result.title: FoMNet: Adaptive Kernels Meet Contextual Matching for Cross-Modal Homography Estimation
result.summary: Cross-modal homography estimation requires reliable correspondences despite appearance differences between sensing modalities. Multi-scale refinement progressively reduces the search range, but its accuracy remains limited by the ability of matching features to distinguish nearby candidates. The vision foundation model (VFM) provides complementary representations, yet integrating these features through fixed interpolation leaves their spatial aggregation independent of image content and the correspondence objective. We propose the Foundation Model-Enhanced Matching Network (FoMNet), which combines learned spatial adaptation of VFM features with contextual correspondence estimation. Patch Feature Upsampling (PFU) progressively predicts location-specific kernels to aggregate neighboring features on upsampled grids, preparing VFM representations for fusion with CNN features at different matching scales. Contextual Correlation Refinement (CCR) then jointly processes source descriptors and local correlations with spatial context to refine candidate scores before each homography update. To reduce upsampling overhead, we develop FoMNet-D, which replaces PFU with bicubic interpolation and uses multi-scale feature-relation distillation to recover accuracy. Experiments on five cross-modal datasets show that FoMNet achieves the lowest mean average corner error (MACE) among the evaluated methods, reducing MACE by 10.6%-72.7% relative to MCNet. FoMNet-D retains competitive accuracy while reducing inference latency by 34.0% relative to FoMNet.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 FoMNet，用于跨模态单应性估计：用 Patch Feature Upsampling 逐步预测位置相关的上采样核，把 VFM 特征按内容聚合并与 CNN 特征融合，再用 Contextual Correlation Refinement 结合空间上下文重估候选对应得分；另有以双三次插值加多尺度特征关系蒸馏的轻量版 FoMNet-D。
AI.relevance_reason: 内容自适应的核预测聚合与逐级候选打分精化，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉特征按任务需要筛选、以及多尺度 latent 假设逐步验证的做法，但论文本身不涉及推理状态或 VLM 推理，需读原文确认可迁移性。
